subject: Next steps: purchase routing & onboarding for BrightWave pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.health>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: purchase routing & onboarding for BrightWave pilot

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Recap
- Pilot scope: 3-month clinical summarization pilot (15k tokens/day average, burst to 50k/day).
- Success metrics: average latency < 250ms p50, summary accuracy spot checks on a 50-case cohort.
- Timeline: target start of pilot week of 11/29 if procurement and onboarding complete.

Procurement readiness questions (we noted on the call)
- Preferred payment method: PO vs credit card? (BrightWave AP preference?)
- Marketplace interest: do you prefer to transact via AWS Marketplace to simplify buying and invoicing?
- Vendor onboarding docs needed: W9, COI (insurance), SOC 2 report, standard PO/invoice remit details.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm whether procurement wants to proceed via PO or if a credit card for an initial pilot is acceptable (we can do a small CC-based trial <$5k).
2) If PO: share the procurement contact and any specific fields your AP system requires on invoices.
3) If you prefer marketplace: let me know the AWS account owner so we can route pricing there.

I've attached a brief mutual action plan and our vendor onboarding checklist to speed things up. Marcus will help with the SOW and can draft language for your PO.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call tomorrow if that helps close the loop.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood-mutual-action-plan.pdf, vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightwave.health>, BrightWave Procurement <procurement@brightwave.health>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: purchase routing & onboarding for BrightWave pilot

Thanks Neha — helpful summary. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Payment method: Procurement prefers a formal PO for anything over $10k. For pilot spend under $5k we sometimes approve credit-card purchases, but that requires pre-approval from AP.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer to keep the pilot off-marketplace for now (vendor onboarding still required for legal reasons), but we're open to marketplace billing later for production.
- Onboarding docs: please send W9, COI, and any SOC 2 evidence. Our vendor portal also needs a finance contact and remit-to address.

Please send an SOW and a draft invoice template (line-item pricing). I'll route those to Samir and the procurement team.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Clinical Innovation
BrightWave Health
elena.ruiz@brightwave.health

Subject: Re: Next steps: purchase routing & onboarding for BrightWave pilot

Elena — thanks for the clarity. A couple clarifications and options so procurement can choose the smoothest path: 

Option A — PO (recommended for longer-term / production)
- Standard flow: we issue an invoice to the remit-to on the PO; payment terms are Net 30 by default (we can discuss Net 45 if needed).
- Documents: we can provide W9, COI, and a SOC 2 attestation package.

Option B — Credit card (fastest for low-risk pilots)
- We can support a one-off card transaction for pilot fees under $5k so you can start immediately while procurement runs the PO.

Option C — Marketplace (AWS/GCP)
- If you prefer AWS Marketplace, we can publish a private listing for the pilot which simplifies billing and procurement approvals — no vendor onboarding required on your side for initial purchase, but marketplace fees apply.

Proposed immediate path to unblock pilot:
1) If PO: please send Samir's procurement contact + the PO template fields you need. We'll draft an SOW and return an invoice-ready doc by EOD 11/17.
2) If card: give me the single-use approver and target spend and we can raise an instant invoice.
3) If marketplace: share your AWS account ID and we can prepare a private marketplace quote (takes ~2–3 business days to set up).

Attaching the vendor-onboarding-checklist again and a placeholder SOW (initial-sow-draft.docx). Marcus will take point on contract language.

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync with Samir if that moves things faster.

Best,
Neha

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, initial-sow-draft.docx

Neha: I drafted a short SOW and invoice template (attached) that aligns with the pilot scope. If you share your procurement contact card, we can produce a PO-ready invoice immediately.

We can also fast-track the onboarding checklist items once Samir confirms the vendor portal contact. I'm happy to take the contracting lead — I'll produce a redline-friendly SOW and share a DocuSign link once terms are agreed.

— Marcus Lin

Marcus / Neha — thanks. Quick update from procurement — Samir (cc'd) is our procurement ops lead and will own the PO. Samir, can you confirm remit-to and PO number format?

Samir, per our policy: anything > $10k needs an approved PO. We expect the pilot will be scoped at ~$12k for the first 3 months so we'll go PO route. Please send the PO template and the contact for vendor portal uploads.

Marcus — please send the invoice to ap@brightwave.health and I'll ask our AP team to expedite once the PO is in. Also please include W9 and COI with the vendor file. If you can provide a DocuSign link for the SOW, we can do an initial signature this week and provision the test environment next week.

Elena
